newsitem.title: USA: Edison buys rest of Australian power plant.
newsitem.headline: Edison buys rest of Australian power plant.

text.p: Edison Mission Energy, a unit of Edison International, announced Monday a deal with the State Electricity Commission of Victoria to acquire the remaining 49 percent of the 1,000-megawatt (MW) Loy Yang B Power Station near Melbourne, Australia.
The plant, consisting of two 500 MW units fired by brown coal, generates around 18 percent of Victoria's electricity.
Edison Mission Energy acquired 51 percent of Loy Yang B in December 1992.
The acquisition of the remaining 49 percent and restructuring of the existing agreements will occur at the close of financing, which is scheduled for early May.
